subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

AUDACITY
solution:
The correct answer is: timidity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Audacity means courage or confidence of a kind that other people find shocking or rude.

 
 
• Example - *He had the **audacity **to tell me I was rude!*
 
 
 
• Marked option Timidity means the state or quality of lacking in self-assurance, courage, or bravery.
 
 
• Example - *He had a slight hesitation in his speech, and his air of **timidity **and reserve was almost ludicrous.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Audacity' and 'Timidity' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Rashness means the quality of being careless or unwise, without thought for what might happen or result.
 
• Boldness means a brave and confident way of behaving that shows no fear.
 
• Bravery means the quality or state of having or showing mental or moral strength to face danger, fear, or difficulty.
